entities.description: A round analog clock with a white face and black Arabic numerals from 1 to 12. The clock has three hands: a short hour hand pointing between 10 and 11, a longer minute hand pointing at 2, and a thin second hand pointing near 7. The clock is encased in a dark, possibly black, circular frame. The image is slightly blurry.

A young woman with long, wavy light brown hair sits on a bed wearing a white t-shirt and a beige quilted sleep mask with a black strap. She has a calm, neutral expression and is looking slightly to the side, with her hands resting on her lap under white bedding.

clothing.accessory: beige quilted sleep mask with black strap
